snippet.title: To Kill Eros BL Visual Novel Trailer
snippet.description:
Celebrating the 1st Anniversary since the public announcement of my visual novel! The 2.0 Demo is available to play on Itch.io, and you can wishlist it on Steam!

Itch.io: https://dokirakii.itch.io/to-kill-eros-bl-vn
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047480/To_Kill_Eros/

To Kill Eros is a drama-filled BL Visual Novel exploring the flavors of love and the depth between people who join hands — while also blaming Eros for everything, of course!

Rated M (18+) for: Violence, Blood, Sexual themes (Non-Explicit), Strong Language, Use of Alcohol and Tobacco (Additional Warnings apply)

Estimated Release Date: Feb 2026 or May 2026

---------✧★*･.｡✧  ✦  ✧★*･.｡✧---------

❥ FOLLOW ME

・SURPRISE ME COMMISSIONS: https://www.vgen.co/dokirakii
・REGULAR COMMISSIONS: https://www.artistree.io/dokirakii
